{"claims":[{"claim_text":"President Biden launched the first-ever National Plan to End Gender-Based Violence.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The American Rescue Plan provided immediate crisis intervention, health supports, and emergency services for survivors.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"President Biden expanded funding for campus sexual assault prevention.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"President Biden is keeping students safe on campus by restoring and strengthening protections under Title IX, including explicit protections for LGBTQI+ students.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"President Biden signed legislation that narrowed the \"boyfriend loophole\" to keep guns out of the hands of domestic abusers.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"President Biden signed into law new protections to support survivors and address sexual assault and sexual harassment in the workplace.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"President Biden signed a historic executive order on sexual assault and domestic violence in the military, transferring key decision-making authority from commanders to independent military prosecutors.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The transfer of key decision-making authority from commanders to independent military prosecutors is the most significant transformation of the military justice system since the Uniform Code of Military Justice was established in 1950.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Trump has made it abundantly clear that he doesn't care about ending violence against women.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Trump failed to reauthorize VAWA as president.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Trump's Administration rolled back campus sexual assault protections, making it even harder for survivors to get the justice they deserve.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
